steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Haaah!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I think I just saw my dead granny calling me over!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Masamune, you're awake! Thank goodness!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So you're one of the previous Iju Hunters? Where's the other one?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: He's not fond of the city, so he stayed in the meowntains.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Midnight said you could get us some equipment.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: If you're going to do the trial, your current gear purr-obably won't cut it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...True.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: My weapon's no use here, and Catapult's out of ammo.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I can use that sword and shield Suponosuke had in his workshop!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Sure, sure, but that charge blade's just for pawtential customers to try.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I can use this bow... but it'll need some adjustments.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Of course it will. You need customized equipmeownt when you go hunting!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: That's why I stopped by in the furst place!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Midnight said you'd be taking us somewhere to get equipped.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But isn't this Suponosuke's house?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Yeah, it is. So why do you guys keep treating it like your own?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Didn't mew know? Suponosuke's the best smith in all of Houei.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: This guy? Seriously?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Purr-cisely.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Forge them some gear, Suponosuke, if you please.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Don't wanna. Too much of a headache.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: The fate of Houei is on the line! How can mew say something like that?!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: I told you I'm busy researching a secret weapon that can save us. Why're you bothering me?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Because mew said the same thing ten years ago!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Because I started the research ten years ago!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: You're such an unreasonable dunderhead!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: You're one to talk!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Wow... This might be the worst display of CQC I've seen in the last few years.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: In terms of his inner nature, this guy's a carbon copy of Spot.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But if you look closely, his house does have a decent pile of weapons.

spans.text: But if you look closely, his house
have a decent pile of weapons.

steps.name: Suponosuke, Scuffling
steps.text: Did you already forget you took that charge blade from me in the first place? You still owe me for that hole in the wall!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Eh? Did I really?

steps.name: Suponosuke, Scuffling
steps.text: Don't play dumb!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Let's get back on track. It's fine if you really don't have much time. At least take a look at my launcher, maybe see if you've got anything I can use for ammo.

steps.name: Suponosuke, Scuffling
steps.text: I—Hmm?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Taste my claws—

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Mya?!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: This weapon... Hmmmmmm? What an elaborate structure. I've never seen materials like these before... So that's how its firing mechanism works... Hmm... I see...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Err... How's it look?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Let's make a deal.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Wait, let me rephrase. If you, Madam Catapult, are willing to entrust me with this weapon for research purposes, I, Suponosuke, shall forge each of you a complete set of equipment.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Err...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Not like I've got any ammo for it. That's alright?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: It's a deal!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Okay, you two sit here. Time for some smithing!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Hurry up and give me the equipment designs for the two ladies already, Masamune.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Talk about an attitude shift! And why're mew being rude only to me?!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: I've got no reason to be nice to you.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Fine, here's the bluepurrints.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: You rang?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'm... a fashion designer. I only wear clothes that have my personal touch. Let me take a look at those designs.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: By all means, Madam Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hmm... It's a good baseline, just needs some tweaking to fit our figures...

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I'm ap-paw-lled by how two-faced and black-hearted you really are, Suponosuke.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Honestly, he seems more like Spot than we thought.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Done.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: This...

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Let me see... Wow, that's purr-etty detailed!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: I wish everyone who had requests for me were like this.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Heheh, just goes to show how much of a pro Orchid is!

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Wait here, I'll get to work right away!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So, what do we do next?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Since we're going to be changing equipment, we should borrow some weapons and do some training.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: What a meow-velous idea!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I've actually got something else to give mew.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Instructions on how to use the bow and the charge blade, along with a Hunting Guide passed down through generations of hunters in Kamura Village!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: And that's not all!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Are these... bugs?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: They're called Wirebugs. Every hunter in Kamura must learn how to use them.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: They're a hunter's best friend, and purr-ficient use of them is the key to a successful hunt.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: C'mon, I'll teach mew to use them!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Whew... Let us call off today's ritual here.

steps.name: Royal Guard
steps.text: You've done well, Your Majesty. Please get some rest.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: What of the Iju Hunters?

steps.name: Royal Guard
steps.text: Sir Masamune has taken them to Master Suponosuke's workshop.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Let us end today's training here.

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: Fine work, Shogun! Please get some rest.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Are the Iju Hunters still at Suponosuke's workshop?

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: They are.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Good, it has been a while since I paid him a visit. I am curious to see his latest invention.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Do not neglect your personal training even after you leave.

steps.name: Samurai Attendant
steps.text: Yes, sir!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Midnight?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Your Majesty?

steps.name: Hofukaru & Midnight
steps.text: Why art thou/are you...

steps.name: Hofukaru & Midnight
steps.text: I came to find the two Iju Hunters...

steps.name: Hofukaru & Midnight
steps.text: But seeing as thou art/you are already looking for them, I—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: May I ask what prompted the shogun to seek the Hunters?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The Hunters' new weapons require exacting techniques to create. I was worried Suponosuke would not be up to the task, and decided to supervise.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Your Majesty need only wait in the palace. There is no need for you to worry about their preparations.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: As smooth a speaker as always, Shogun.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The Hunters shall be my two arms in this trial, so 'tis only natural that I prepare their equipment personally. There is no need to trouble thyself, Shogun.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Your Majesty has such a busy schedule, though. Allow me to handle this trifle in your stead.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Thou hast been hard at work leading the Hunter's Association both day and night, Shogun. Pray rest a while.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: What's all this ruckus?! Why's my house so popular today?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Oh, Your Majesty? What brings you here?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: And Midnight too. I already told you, those weapons can't be made that quickly.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I know. I came to see an old friend, nothing more.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Hearing that from you is kinda gross, honestly.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Where are Madam Orchid and Madam Catapult?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: They're training in the bamboo grove out back.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: You here for them too?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I suppose we are.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Then go talk to them. I'm worried they'll end up chopping down all the bamboo there.

steps.name: Hofukaru & Midnight
steps.text: No need, I shall await them here until they are done training.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: ...Then how about I get you some chairs?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Err, so you're saying this stupid-looking cloudbeast on the scroll is you, Masamune?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I do not look stupid! Lady Minoto just has a purr-ticular painting style!

spans.text: look stupid! Lady Minoto just has a purr-ticular painting style!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Okay, I think I get how to use the charge blade now!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Attack and attack until the sword's glowing, then push it into the shield until it clicks, then unleash a super attack! Right?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: No! The charge blade's a complex weapon, there's a lot mew need to keep in mind!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Look, I'm no good with book learning. I'm a hands-on kinda girl.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Talk about a pain in the tail...

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Fine, fine, then show me how to use these Wirebugs instead!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Their most basic use is for mewvement. Grab onto the thread it secretes, throw it in the direction mew want to go—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Whoa, that's fast! Bamboo incoming—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: —And you'll mewve really fast, just like that.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: These bugs are amazing, Orchid! Its silk managed to pull me the entire way without snapping!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Wirebug silk is called Ironsilk, and it is stronger than you can imagine. As I said, mewvement is just the most basic use. It'll be a lot of help during a fight.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Would mew like to try it, Orchid?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Check it out, Orchid! I can climb up this high in no time!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Haha! This is way too fun!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Let's keep going—Eh?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Meow! I didn't have time to explain, but you can't keep using Wirebugs without pawse! We need to catch her—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You said Ironsilk is really strong. Can it support the weight of two people?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Heheh, always knew you had my back, Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Stop trying to show off. Wirebugs might be strong, but it'll take us a while to get used to them, not to mention all the techniques we need to learn. Stop wasting time.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yes, ma'am—!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I'm so glad you're such a sensible purr-son, Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I do have one question, Masamune.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: You rang?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You're one of the previous Iju Hunters, yes? Midnight won't allow Hofukaru to challenge the Lord of Thunder, which means he's certainly not letting you act freely either.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: If you promised Midnight to wait until Her Majesty is ready before challenging the Lord, then you have no reason to concern yourself with us.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So is there any meaning in helping us?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't misunderstand me, I'm not doubting you. I just don't like accepting kindness without knowing where it comes from.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: A purr-fectly reasonable question. I'll need to go into our history to explain things.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So you're saying you and your friend followed the Lord of Thunder here? Meaning all three of you came from the same place?!

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Purr-cisely.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: 'Lord of Thunder' isn't its real name, it's just what the people of Houei call it in fear...

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Its real name... is the Zinogre.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Yoshitsune and I are members of the Kamura Village Meowcenaries. Our job is to go out into the field and collect materials, which is when we ran into the Zinogre.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: As we were tracking it, we somehow found ourselves in Houei.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Then why'd you stop me from stopping Hofukaru's ritual? That's got nothing to do with the Zinogre.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: But it does. It is connected to meowst of what's happening here. Interrupting Her Meowjesty wouldn't have done any good!

spans.text: . It is connected to meowst of what's happening here. Interrupting Her Meowjesty wouldn't have done any good!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: ...Fine.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That still doesn't explain why you'd help us.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Mew've seen the curse for yourselves, yes?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: The cursed beasts emit a black smoke, and are more vicious than ordinary beasts. Ignoring it might cause more damage than the Iju itself.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Back in my hometown of Kamura, there was something pawfully similar.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: The Frenzy.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Can you tell us more about that?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: It's terrifying. Infected beasts give off black miasma, and go purr-serk.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: The same symptoms, then.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Basically... You suspect the curse spreading across Houei, and the Iju themselves, are both from your homeland?

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Purr-cisely. Because the Frenzy has a very obvious source.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But if that's the case, aren't Houei's trials...

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: That, I dare not say for sure.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: The curse and the Frenzy have their similarities, but I have no purr-oof they are the same.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: I've spent years looking for that purr-oof. If they really are one and the same, then this goes far beyond Iju hunting.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Mya! What was that for?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Nothing, just suddenly felt like rubbing your fur.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Let's get back to training.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The sun will soon set, Shogun. Mayhaps thou shouldst head home first?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I should be making that suggestion. It is just about a child's bedtime.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: How long dost thou intend to treat me as a child?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Until Your Majesty no longer tries to refute me on this matter.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Hofukaru & Midnight
steps.text: Madam Orchid!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Why're you two standing here?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I was waiting for you and Madam Catapult.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I came to see if thou needst any assistance.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *sigh* Sorry, but I'm really tired. Could we save this for later?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Where's Suponosuke?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: At your service, ma'am!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Is our equipment ready yet?

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: It'll take a little more time, but it should be ready by tomorrow.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: As for you two—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Your Majesty, Catapult and I intend to accept the trial, and will help you take down the current Iju.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: However, we cannot guarantee that our current skills are enough to hunt the Lord of Thunder.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: That being the case, if you wish to hunt it with us, we must respectfully decline. My apologies.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...I understand.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Thank you, Madam Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't thank me just yet. This doesn't mean I'm taking your side.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: This is my own decision.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: That is more than enough.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: And with that—

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I think we're done here.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Why aren't you two heading home?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Perhaps I could be of assistance during this rare opportunity.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I shall help too!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't move, Hofukaru.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: There's a tear in your clothes. Come over here—I'll mend it for you.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Ah? But...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't worry, it's no trouble. Now come closer.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Mhm.

Midnight considers using this opportunity to continue discussing the matter of the Lord of Thunder with Her Majesty and the two Iju Hunters, but a glance from Orchid sends him skulking back to the door.
He is unsure why, but he could sense the meaning behind her look: 'Now isn't the time to talk about that'.
He is shocked that he was able to understand her glance, and even more shocked at how she seemed to know what he was thinking.
The light of the setting sun scatters across the old workshop, illuminating the dust floating through the air and coating everything in a sheen of indistinctness.
The girl obediently leans against the door frame as the worried woman silently stitches up her clothes.
As for the younger woman, she is currently enjoying Masamune's tutelage, combining and splitting her sword and shield over and over, as if that action was the essence of hunting itself.
Midnight's mind wanders back to an afternoon ten years ago.
The sunset that day was as beautiful as this one. He guarded the workshop, allowing none to approach as the tiny Hofukaru stumbled past him to enter.
That day, he stood as he did now, glancing at things happening within from the outside.
Suponosuke was engrossed in researching hunting equipment as per usual, as the young Hofukaru giddily picked up an axe, swinging it about.

The former lord was engaged in a discussion about equipment with the other master smiths, but upon seeing Hofukaru at play, she cut their conversation short, guiding her daughter on how to wield her weapon.
Orchid looks nothing like the former lord. Her Majesty was dignified and august, while Orchid is gentle and attentive. Nor does Catapult remind him of anyone in particular.
However, he cannot stop his memories of that time from bubbling to the surface.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Heheh...

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: What's got mew laughing like that?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Orchid's finally back to her usual self.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Her mewsual self?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Her brow's been scrunched up ever since we got here—actually, that's pretty normal now that I think about it. Feels different, though.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: In what way?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Usually she comes across like you owe her a million dollars. But ever since we got here, it's been more like she owes everyone else a million dollars. Broke my heart to see her like that.

spans.text: Usually she comes across like you owe her a million dollars. But ever since we got here, it's been more like she owes
a million dollars. Broke my heart to see her like that.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But now I can relax. She's got that leader aura back.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Mew really care about her.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Of course I do. She's our leader, after all.

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: Grave news, Shogun!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: The mountain... According to our scout's report, the snowy mountain has begun to change!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: How so?

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: It... It's heating up!
